hits.title: Sprout Social Layoffs 2026: 260 Employees Affected
hits.snippet: ## Impact on Operations The 260 affected employees span multiple departments, with the heaviest cuts falling in areas where AI automation now handles core functions. Sales support, customer success, and certain marketing operations roles saw significant reductions. Engineering teams focused on legacy infrastructure were also affected as the company consolidates resources around its next-generation AI product suite. Sprout Social's primary operations are based in Chicago, Illinois, with additional teams working remotely across North America and in international markets. The layoffs affect employees across these locations. Affected workers received notification on July 15, 2026, and the company indicated it would provide severance packages and career transition support. [...] Sprout Social's July 2026 layoffs are part of a broader wave of AI-driven restructurings sweeping the SaaS and social media software sector, as companies race to embed generative AI into their core products while reducing headcount in functions being automated away. Competitors and peers in the social media management space have similarly realigned their workforces to reflect leaner, AI-augmented operating model

hits.title: Sprout Social cuts 20% of workforce in restructuring plan
hits.snippet: © Reuters. In this article: SPT-3.58% Investing.com -- Sprout Social began notifying employees on Tuesday about a workforce reduction that will eliminate approximately 260 positions, or 20% of its staff. The company’s board approved the restructuring plan on July 8, 2026. The social media management company said the plan aims to streamline its organizational structure and align costs with strategic priorities, including ongoing investments in AI-powered social intelligence. Sprout Social estimates it will incur pre-tax restructuring charges between $18.0 million and $20.0 million related to the workforce reduction. The charges will consist primarily of cash expenditures for employee severance payments and benefits. [...] The company expects to recognize substantially all of these charges in the third quarter of 2026. Sprout Social plans to complete the restructuring by the end of the third quarter, subject to local law and consultation requirements. _This article was generated with the support of AI and reviewed by an editor.
